rows.behavior: kmctl new KIND TITLE --description TEXT creates the concept for each of decision, practice, proposal, prototype and handoff, with its front matter and that kind's heading skeleton.
rows.fails_when: for any kind the file is missing, misnamed, lacks type, title, description, tags or generated, or lacks the skeleton headings

rows.behavior: Decisions get the next four-digit number and handoffs get a stale_after date.
rows.fails_when: a new decision's number is not one more than the highest, or a handoff has no stale_after

rows.behavior: The first concept in a section creates the section folder, its index.md and the root index link.
rows.fails_when: after the first concept, the section index or the root link is missing

rows.behavior: Each new concept is indexed and logged, kmctl check passes, and the bundle passes the pinned okf validator in strict mode.
rows.fails_when: the section index has no entry, log.md has no line naming the id, kmctl check exits nonzero, or the strict validator exits nonzero

rows.behavior: It refuses, writing nothing, when the file already exists, including two handoffs with the same title.
rows.fails_when: any file changes or the command exits 0
